column1: Our activities affect millions of people around
the globe, including those far beyond our direct
operations. This means we have a critical role
to play in respecting and promoting human
rights. We believe everyone should be treated
with fundamental dignity and respect and
provided an equal opportunity to thrive, which
is why at Amazon, respecting human rights is
everyone’s responsibility—one we are always
working to embed into the business decisions
we make every day. Our work is informed by the
United Nations Guiding Principles on Business
and Human Rights (UNGPs), and we have high
standards in place that support our long-standing
commitment to advancing the human rights of
all people connected to our business—including
our employees, people who work in our supply
chain, customers, and people who live in the
